title: Astonishing Secrets About the World's Smallest Snake

scenes.text: Meet the world's smallest snake, only 4 inches long!
It's called the Barbados Threadsnake, discovered in 2008.
This tiny snake can burrow in the soil and preys on tiny insects.
It’s so small, you might miss it!
Follow so you never run out of fun facts.

description: Dive into the world of the Barbados Threadsnake, a marvel of nature! This tiny reptile is a surprising testament to evolution.
